summary: Portable pinned lease backend for isolated verification

delivery.outcome: Publish portable, digest-bound lease loading and reproduce the real lease test in a networkless container without developer files.
nonGoals: Changing lease semantics or approval authority
Editing the concurrent delivery controller or panel
Deploying shared OneDev services or weakening browser isolation

architecture.decision: Vendor the exact already-pinned dependency, with provenance and digest. Verify and execute one immutable byte buffer; reject symbolic links. Keep the external cooperative store and adopted transition policy unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Restore the previous adapter and dependency placement; external lease state is unchanged.

validation.evidence: Networkless unprivileged container with clean HOME and no developer mounts
Digest, missing-file, symlink and verified-byte regressions
Managed scope and adopted policy checks
Protected OneDev and Validator exact-head receipts; local tests do not grant approval
